body:
For posterity, you can force the old behaviour with
```toml
[tool.poetry.build]
generate-setup-file = true
script = "math import *;build = lambda _: _;from math"
```
Although, as cool as Python injection is, I would prefer to avoid doing this!

issue.title: env: enable usersite for system environments

repository.name: poetry
repository.description: Python packaging and dependency management made easy

body:
@agoose77 in most cases I would recommend that you use a poetry manage virtual environment. Using system sites are not recommended for applications. 

Also, `poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true` can also be useful.

> @agoose77 in most cases I would recommend that you use a poetry manage virtual environment. Using system sites are not recommended for applications. 
> 
> Also, `poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true` can also be useful.

Thanks. Normally I use a venv for those reasons, and it's great. I need to avoid using one here because it greatly simplifies my docker image (which has several ways of being used). Pip seems to default to using the XDG local environment, could poetry respect that too?

@agoose77 using a poetry managed environment should not make a difference here tbh. As in just change the entry point to `poetry shell` and you should always have a ready environment etc. But yeah, I understand use cases might be different.

See if the fix i proposed in #3000 works for now. Its a bit tricky sometimes to decide between what site to use.

It is a slight pain for me because I have an SSH server in the image, and I build Dev and prod images - having a redundant venv in there is a pain :)  that was a really quick fix, thanks!! I'll take a look first thing tomorrow .
